## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link a related issue if there is one.

## Validation

List the commands and manual checks performed, with their results. For documentation-only work, note link and content checks. Include screenshots or a preview for visible UI changes when available.

## Review notes

Call out anything the reviewer should focus on, including setup changes, integration boundaries or remaining limitations. Remove this section if unnecessary.

- [ ] The change is focused and follows the repository language and brand boundaries.
- [ ] Relevant checks are complete; application or shared-config changes pass `pnpm check`.
- [ ] No secrets, local environment files, temporary audit assets or private collaboration material are included.

Follow the active review phase in `CONTRIBUTING.md`. Independent approval is optional in the current one-maintainer phase. Once shared review is activated, another human collaborator must approve and new changes require a fresh review.
